Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
nullchk;
BEGIN
 SELECT create_date, to_warehouse, code_desc
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.create_date, :ctrl_blk_1.to_warehouse,
 :ctrl_blk_1.to_wh_desc
 FROM lab_wh_trans_hdr, vserv_master vm
 WHERE batch_status = 'CLOSE' 
 and batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and vm.code_type = 'LTYPE'
 and vm.code = lab_wh_trans_hdr.to_warehouse
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
EXCEPTION 
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1097');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END ;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :recon_reason is null then
 show_error('0263');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit_form;
 IF not form_success THEN
 :system.message_level := 0;
 message('Error in Commit. Contact IS');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('8010');
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF :recon_reason is not null THEN
 :receive_user := :banner.user_id;
 :receive_date := trunc(sysdate);
 :receive_warehouse := :global.warehouse;
/* If the product code is null update warehouse id in units and insert 'WTP, 'NFT' into 
 Unit Interdictions, else update components and insert interdiction 'WTP', 'NFT'
 into Component Interdictions remove INTR interdiction*/

 if :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code is null then
 begin
 update units
 set warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in updating Units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and inter_code = 'WTP';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code, insert_dats,
 inter_user_id, program_id)
 values
 (:lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id, :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'WTP', sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in inserting into Unit Interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 /* begin
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code, insert_dats,
 inter_user_id, program_id)
 values
 (:lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id, :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'NFT', sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in inserting into Unit Interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;*/
 
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and coll_date = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date
 and inter_code = 'INTR'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in deleting from Unit Interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin 
 update components
 set warehouse_id = :GLOBAL.warehouse
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and coll_date = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date
 and product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code
 and component_prefix = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.aliquot
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in updating Components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and inter_code = 'WTP';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 insert into component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code, inter_code,
 insert_dats, inter_user_id, program_id)
 values
 (:lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id, :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code, 'WTP', sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in inserting into Component Interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
/*
 begin
 insert into component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code, inter_code,
 insert_dats, inter_user_id, program_id)
 values
 (:lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id, :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code, 'NFT', sysdate, :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error in inserting into Component Interdictions');

 */ 
 begin
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.unit_id
 and coll_date = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.coll_date
 and product_code = :lab_wh_trans_dtl.product_code
 and inter_code = 'INTR'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception

 end if;

Trigger.Name: POST-FORMS-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 n_rem number(4) := 0;
 v_sysdate date;
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 SELECT count(*)
 INTO n_rem
 FROM lab_wh_trans_dtl
 WHERE batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and receive_user is NULL
 and receive_date is NULL ;
 
 IF n_rem = 0 THEN
 -- time zone change --5/8/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 04/19/2012. IM 8411
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 -- End of commented section */
 -- Added code by Kishore on 04/19/2012. IM 8411
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := v_local_time;
 -- End of change
 else
 --v_sysdate := to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/19/2012. IM 8411
 v_sysdate := sysdate; -- Added by Kishore on 04/19/2012. IM 8411
 end if;
 
 UPDATE lab_wh_trans_hdr
 SET recon_user = :banner.user_id,
 recon_date = trunc(v_sysdate) ,
 batch_status = 'RECON'
 WHERE batch_id = :lab_WH_TRANS_DTL.batch_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION 
 when others then
 message('Error in reconciliation of batch' || sqlerrm);
 handle_error;
END ;
